full_prompt_en: A square painted icon shows a haloed winged figure holding a slender staff against a dark red and gold ornamental ground. The background is dense with aged burgundy pigment, small circular emblems, and worn gilt details, making the central head and shoulders appear close to the picture surface. A broad round halo rises behind the figure's brown curls and reaches nearly to the upper edge. The face is pale warm cream, gently shaded beneath the eyes and around the narrow nose, with a small closed mouth and a calm forward gaze. The head tilts a little to one side rather than standing perfectly rigid. At both sides, layered wings spread outward from behind the shoulders. Their feathers alternate ocher, olive green, rust red, and deep shadow, giving the symmetrical shape a richly varied surface. The figure wears an ornate garment whose chest is covered with gold pattern, tiny circular accents, and curved bands. A brilliant red-orange drape crosses one shoulder and folds over the arm, while pale inner sleeves emerge near the lower corners. One hand grips a long thin staff rising diagonally toward the upper-left edge; the other arm rests lower within the mass of patterned clothing. The paint appears aged and granular, with darkened recesses, abrasion, and uneven gold catching the light across the halo, fabric, and wings. Fine dark outlines separate face, fingers, feathers, and ornamental bands, but much of the garment merges into a continuous field of detail. Illumination seems frontal and even, making the face and gilded shapes glow without a strong cast shadow. The overall composition is formal and centered, using the repeated gold, red, and green pattern to frame a serene figure within a compact sacred image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画圣像描绘一位带光环的有翼人物手持细杖，背后是深红与金色的装饰底面。背景布满陈旧的酒红色颜料、细小圆形纹章和磨损的镀金细节，使中央的头肩仿佛贴近画面表层。一圈宽大的圆形光环从棕色卷发后升起，几乎碰到上缘。面部呈暖奶油色，眼下和细长鼻子周围有轻柔的暗部，嘴小而闭合，目光平静地向前。头部微微偏向一侧，并非完全僵直。两侧，层叠的翅膀从肩后向外张开。羽毛交替出现赭黄、橄榄绿、铁锈红和深影，使对称形状具有丰富变化的表面。人物身穿华丽衣饰，胸前覆着金色纹样、细小圆点和弧形饰带。鲜亮的红橙色披布越过一侧肩膀，在手臂上形成褶皱，浅色内袖从下方两角露出。一只手握着长而细的杖，斜向左上边缘升起；另一只手臂在带纹样的衣服中位置较低。颜料显得陈旧而带颗粒，凹处发暗，光环、衣料和翅膀上的磨蚀与不均匀金色共同反光。细深色轮廓分开脸、手指、羽毛和装饰带，但衣服的大部分细节仍汇成连续的繁密区域。光线近乎正面且均匀，使面部和镀金形状发亮，没有强烈投影。整体构图正式而居中，反复出现的金、红、绿纹样把平静的人物框在紧凑的神圣图像中。
style_prompt_en: The painting has an aged, granular surface with rubbed gold, dense ornamental color, and darkened recesses. Broad circular forms and near-symmetrical side masses establish a frontal, centered order, while small irregular strokes prevent the surface from becoming mechanically flat. Warm cream and dull gold supply the highest values, surrounded by burgundy, rust red, olive green, and nearly black accents. Fine dark contours define selected details, then disappear into continuous decorated areas. Layered color and visible abrasion give the matte surface the weight of an old painted panel. Light appears even and frontal, producing a gentle metallic glow rather than directional shadows. Shallow space and repeated decorative bands keep attention on the central form. The overall effect is solemn and luminous, joining precise pattern with the patina of wear.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画表面陈旧而带颗粒，磨过的金色、密集的装饰色彩与发暗的凹处共同显现。宽阔圆形与近乎对称的两侧体块建立正面居中的秩序，细小的不规则笔迹又使表面不会显得机械平板。暖奶油色与暗金色占据最高明度，周围环绕酒红、铁锈红、橄榄绿及近黑色重音。纤细深色轮廓界定选定细节，又在连续的装饰区域中消失。层叠色彩和可见磨蚀赋予哑光表面旧彩绘板的重量。光感均匀而偏正面，产生温和的金属光泽，而非定向阴影。浅空间与重复饰带让视线集中在中央形体。整体效果庄严而发亮，把精确纹样与磨损形成的包浆结合起来。
theme_en: A haloed winged figure holding a slender staff
theme_zh: 一位带光环、手持细杖的有翼人物
name: Byzantine icon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
